paragraphs: Oracle Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Co-founded in Santa Clara, California, in 1977 by Bob Miner, Ed Oates, and current chairman of the board and chief technology officer Larry Ellison, Oracle is among the 50 largest companies in the world by market cap, and ranked 52nd on the Forbes Global 2000 as of 2026.

The company sells database software (particularly the Oracle Database), enterprise applications, and cloud infrastructure and hardware. Oracle's core application software is a suite of enterprise software products, including enterprise resource planning (ERP), human capital management (HCM), customer experience (CX) and supply chain management (SCM) software.

people.name: Lawrence J. Ellison
people.title: Executive Chair of the Board of Directors and Chief Technology Officer
people.bio: Founded Oracle in June 1977 and served as Chief Executive Officer until September 2014. He has been a director since June 1977 and Executive Chair and Chief Technology Officer since September 2014.
people.quote: Mr. Ellison, 81, has been our Executive Chair of the Board and Chief Technology Officer since September 2014.

people.name: Clayton M. Magouyrk
people.title: Chief Executive Officer and Director
people.bio: Became Chief Executive Officer in September 2025 after serving as President, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and in executive vice president roles. Before joining Oracle in 2014, he was a senior engineer at Amazon and Amazon Web Services.
people.quote: Mr. Magouyrk, 39, has been our Chief Executive Officer since September 2025.

people.name: Michael D. Sicilia
people.title: Chief Executive Officer and Director
people.bio: Became Chief Executive Officer in September 2025 after serving as President, Industries and in executive vice president roles. Before joining Oracle in 2009, he was Chief Technology Officer at Primavera Systems and held other positions there.
people.quote: Mr. Sicilia, 55, has been our Chief Executive Officer since September 2025.

people.name: Mark Hura
people.title: President, Global Field Operations
people.bio: Became President, Global Field Operations in September 2025 after holding executive leadership roles in Oracle's cloud infrastructure and technology sales organizations. Before joining Oracle in 2013, he served as General Manager of Sales for General Electric's Digital Energy business.
people.quote: Mr. Hura, 52, has been our President, Global Field Operations since September 2025.

people.name: Hilary Maxson
people.title: Chief Financial Officer and Principal Financial Officer
people.bio: Joined Oracle as Chief Financial Officer in April 2026. Previously, she served as Executive Vice President and Group Chief Financial Officer of Schneider Electric from 2020 until April 2026.
people.quote: Ms. Maxson, 48, has been our Chief Financial Officer since April 2026.

people.name: Safra A. Catz
people.title: Executive Vice Chair of the Board of Directors
people.bio: Served as Oracle's Chief Executive Officer from September 2014 to September 2025 before becoming Executive Vice Chair. She previously served as President and Chief Financial Officer and has been a director since October 2001.
people.quote: Ms. Catz, 64, has been our Executive Vice Chair of the Board since September 2025.

people.name: Jeffrey O. Henley
people.title: Executive Vice Chair of the Board of Directors
people.bio: Served as Chairman of the Board from January 2004 to September 2014 before becoming Executive Vice Chair. He was Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer from March 1991 to July 2004 and has been a director since June 1995.
people.quote: Mr. Henley, 81, has been our Executive Vice Chair of the Board since September 2014.

people.name: Stuart Levey
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer
people.bio: Has served as Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer since October 2022. Previously, he served as Chief Executive Officer of Diem Association and Chief Legal Officer of HSBC Holdings.
people.quote: Mr. Levey, 63, has been our Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer since October 2022.

people.name: Maria Smith
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer
people.bio: Has served as Executive Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer since December 2022. Since joining Oracle in 1999, she has held roles including Senior Vice President, Corporate Controller and Senior Vice President, Assistant Corporate Controller.
people.quote: Ms. Smith, 60, has been our Executive Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer since December 2022.

people.name: Douglas Kehring
people.title: Executive Vice President and Head of Operations
people.bio: Is listed as Executive Vice President and Head of Operations. He also served as Principal Financial Officer from September 22, 2025 to April 6, 2026, when Hilary Maxson assumed that role.
people.quote: Mr. Kehring served as PFO for part of fiscal 2026, from September 22, 2025 to April 6, 2026

people.name: Jeffrey S. Berg
people.title: Director
people.bio: Berg has served as Chairman of Northside Services, LLC since May 2015. He was Chairman and CEO of International Creative Management, Inc. from 1985 to 2012.
people.quote: Mr. Berg has been an agent, media executive and adviser in the entertainment industry for over 45 years.

people.name: Michael J. Boskin
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Boskin is the Tully M. Friedman Professor of Economics and Rose and Milton Friedman Senior Fellow at Stanford University's Hoover Institution. He is CEO and President of Boskin & Co., Inc. and formerly chaired the President's Council of Economic Advisers.
people.quote: Dr. Boskin currently serves as a director of Bloom Energy Corporation.

people.name: Safra A. Catz
people.title: Executive Vice Chair
people.bio: Catz has been Oracle's Executive Vice Chair since September 2025 and previously served as CEO from September 2014 to September 2025. She joined Oracle in 1999 and also previously served as President and CFO.
people.quote: Ms. Catz has been our Executive Vice Chair since September 2025.

people.name: Bruce R. Chizen
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Chizen is an independent consultant, Senior Adviser to Permira Advisers LLP and Strategic Advisor at Voyager Capital. He previously served as Adobe's CEO from 2000 to 2007.
people.quote: Mr. Chizen currently serves as Board Chair of ChargePoint, Inc. and as a director of Synopsys, Inc.

people.name: Lawrence J. Ellison
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Ellison founded Oracle in June 1977 and served as CEO until September 2014. He has been Executive Chair of the Board and CTO since September 2014.
people.quote: Mr. Ellison has been our Executive Chair of the Board and CTO since September 2014.

people.name: Rona A. Fairhead
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Fairhead served as the United Kingdom's Minister of State for Trade and Export Promotion from September 2017 to May 2019. She previously chaired the BBC Trust and served as Chair and CEO of the Financial Times Group Limited.
people.quote: Mrs. Fairhead also serves as a non-executive director of The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust and is a crossbench member of the U.K. House of Lords.

people.name: Jeffrey O. Henley
people.title: Executive Vice Chair
people.bio: Henley has served as Oracle's Executive Vice Chair of the Board since September 2014 and previously chaired the Board from January 2004 to September 2014. He served as Executive Vice President and CFO from March 1991 to July 2004.
people.quote: Mr. Henley has served as our Executive Vice Chair of the Board since September 2014.

people.name: Clayton M. Magouyrk
people.title: Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Magouyrk has been Oracle's CEO since September 2025, following service as President of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and in executive vice president roles. He joined Oracle in 2014 after working as a senior engineer at Amazon and Amazon Web Services.
people.quote: Mr. Magouyrk has been our CEO since September 2025.

people.name: Tomislav Mihaljevic
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Mihaljevic has been Chief Executive Officer and President, and Morton L. Mandel CEO Chair of Cleveland Clinic since January 2018. He previously served as CEO of Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi from 2015 to 2017.
people.quote: Dr. Mihaljevic joined Cleveland Clinic in 2004 as a surgeon in the Department of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery.

people.name: Charles W. Moorman
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Moorman served as Amtrak's President and CEO from August 2016 to January 2018 and Senior Advisor from 2018 to 2025. He previously served as CEO and Chairman of Norfolk Southern Corporation.
people.quote: During the last five years, Mr. Moorman previously served as a director of Chevron Corporation.

people.name: Stephen H. Rusckowski
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Rusckowski served as Chief Executive Officer and President of Quest Diagnostics, Inc. from 2012 until 2022.
people.quote: Mr. Rusckowski is the former Chief Executive Officer and President from 2012 until 2022 of Quest Diagnostics, Inc.

people.name: Michael D. Sicilia
people.title: Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Sicilia was appointed as Oracle's CEO on September 22, 2025 and has been a director since 2025.
